title: LumiXAI: A Modular Full-Stack Framework for Feature Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2608.24524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feature attribution is a central tool of model interpretability, yet the software through which it is applied remains fragmented: individual tools specialize along narrow axes, such as a single modality, a code API or a GUI, or a fixed rather than extensible method set, and rarely combine these strengths. Moreover, many explainability tools are designed primarily for domain experts, requiring programming skills or familiarity with attribution methods that can make them difficult for non-expert users to access. In this article, we present LumiXAI, a modular full-stack framework that consolidates attribution analysis into a single system. It couples classification and generative attribution with an interactive GUI supporting bidirectional exploration, a plug-in architecture for registering new models and methods, and three access tiers serving non-programmers, developers, and extenders from one backend. translated_title: LumiXAI：一个模块化全栈特征归因框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24524v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：特征归因是模型可解释性的核心工具，但其应用软件仍然碎片化：各个工具沿狭窄轴专门化，如单一模态、代码API或图形界面，或固定而非可扩展的方法集，很少结合这些优势。此外，许多可解释性工具主要面向领域专家设计，需要编程技能或对归因方法的熟悉，这可能使非专家用户难以访问。在本文中，我们提出了LumiXAI，一个模块化全栈框架，将归因分析整合到单一系统中。它将分类和生成式归因与支持双向探索的交互式图形界面、用于注册新模型和方法的插件架构，以及从同一后端服务非程序员、开发者和扩展者的三个访问层级相结合。其贡献在于一个系统。
tldr: LumiXAI是一个模块化全栈框架，通过交互式界面、插件架构和三层访问设计，统一了特征归因分析，使非专家也能轻松使用。
en_tdlr: LumiXAI is a modular full-stack framework that unifies feature attribution analysis through an interactive GUI, plug-in architecture, and three-tier access, making it accessible to non-experts.
